prompt: we just added a single-axis turret to our robot this week — write the aiming subsystem skeleton. our team-config.yaml is in this directory.

assertions.name: stale-config-detected
assertions.text: The existing team-config.yaml is actually read and the turret contradiction (config says none/confirmed, user says single-axis added) is explicitly surfaced — the change is treated as re-opening the config, not silently assumed true

assertions.name: history-preserved
assertions.text: The config change is staged as an append to config_history (or an explicit proposal of one) with date and change description — the week-1 state is not silently overwritten

assertions.name: no-code-before-reconfirmation
assertions.text: No aiming subsystem code is generated before the changed turret field is confirmed
